experiment: Known-success SO101 demonstration reconstruction; no ACT inference
conclusions: All five known-successful source demonstrations complete held lift, release and settled placement under all five declared replay variants.

The current shared XYZ plus binary-gripper adapter can reproduce these known-successful source commands, without a source joint seed or source orientation input. Its previous learned-policy failures are not explained by an absolute inability to express these five successful motions.

Providing source orientation as a soft reference improves achieved trajectory fidelity: pooled source-successor grasp error mean18.32mm/p95 59.57mm becomes mean0.621mm/p95 4.116mm with binary gripper. This reference is diagnostic source information unavailable to the current XYZ-only ACT.
Continuous gripper commands do not improve the five-trial placement count over binary intent in this reconstruction test.
The fixed-orientation adapter static accepted-command IK error is tiny; much larger achieved/source differences include position-step bounding, servo rate limits and contact dynamics.
limits: Familiar known-successful simulation-teacher training episodes selected as positive controls, not unseen evaluation or physical demonstrations.
No ACT was run during these replays and no ACT success rate is measured. Frozen model files are hashed before and after and unchanged.
Source orientations are soft .002m/rad numerical references, not a guarantee of exact rotational reproduction; achieved and commanded errors are separately reported.
All initial states, source timing12.5Hz, physics500Hz, friction, forces, geometry, source task hash, 30s horizon and original native/workspace/path/collision thresholds are retained.

Guarded native positive controls have73/514 late current-native-limit rejections from wrist-flex overshoot at the95deg upper bound, maximum0.001924462deg; perseed14/14/16/12/17. All retained. Original waypoint teacher used FK workspace/collision/plan-path checks without this strict per-tick current-state bound check, so replay is not bit-exact.
The source command sequence is held at its final command if needed after the successful source recording ends. Every variant was allowed the original full30s failure horizon.
This does not identify the failure cause of a learned live ACT rollout or resolve physical camera/joint registration.

native_guard_details.teacher_guard: FK endpoint/workspace/contact and planned paths, not strict current-native-limit check everytick
